description: Full memory bootstrap for session recovery. Returns core (permanent knowledge), working (ongoing context/decisions), buffer (transient), recent activity, and session notes. Use workspace tags to filter by current work context. Compact mode (default) minimizes token usage.

namespace.description: Filter by namespace (also includes "default" namespace automatically)

recent_epochs.description: Number of consolidation epochs to look back for recent section (default 24). Epoch-based: only counts active consolidation cycles, not wall-clock time.

workspace.description: Comma-separated workspace tags to filter core/working memories (e.g. 'engram,rust')

name: engram_resume
